description: This file defines a utility class ServiceEcaUtil for managing and evaluating Event-Condition-Action (ECA) rules related to services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading, caching, and merging ECA definitions, as well as evaluating rules based on events.

classes.name: ServiceEcaUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing Service ECA (Event-Condition-Action) rules, including loading, caching, and evaluating rules associated with services in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Clears the ECA cache and reloads the configuration of ECA rules.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads ECA rules definitions from configuration files and component resources, populating the cache.

methods.name: addEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Adds ECA definitions from a given resource handler into the cache.

methods.name: getEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves ECA rules from a resource handler by parsing XML documents.

methods.name: mergeEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Merges provided ECA rules into the cache, replacing duplicates.

methods.name: getServiceEventMap
methods.description: Retrieves the event map for a specific service name from the cache.

methods.name: getServiceEventRules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of ECA rules for a specific service and event.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates applicable ECA rules for a given service event, executing actions as defined.
